description: React component library for AG-UI protocol — connects any React app to any AG-UI SSE endpoint
url_first_contract: One piece of information is required to use this library: the URL of an AG-UI-compliant SSE endpoint.

components.name: AGUIProvider
components.note: headers and onError must be stable references (no inline objects or arrow functions)

awaiting_confirmation.trigger: TOOL_CALL_RESULT event where content contains requires_confirmation: true
awaiting_confirmation.meaning: A draft action has arrived and is waiting for human confirmation. result contains draft_id, preview_title, preview_detail.

error_codes.trigger: fetch() throws — endpoint unreachable, CORS rejected, DNS failure
error_codes.action: Check endpoint URL and backend CORS configuration

error_codes.trigger: 5 consecutive CONNECTION_FAILED events with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s)
error_codes.action: Backend is down; no further reconnect attempts

error_codes.trigger: Malformed SSE line (not valid JSON after 'data: ' prefix)
error_codes.action: Check backend SSE format; stream continues after warning

error_codes.trigger: Backend sends RUN_ERROR event with code: 'TOOL_REJECTED'
error_codes.action: Tool call was rejected by the agent; isStreaming returns to false

error_codes.trigger: Backend sends RUN_ERROR event without TOOL_REJECTED code
error_codes.action: Agent encountered an error; inspect error.message for details

error_codes.trigger: STATE_DELTA event contains an RFC 6902 patch that fast-json-patch rejects
error_codes.action: Check backend STATE_DELTA ops; state is left unchanged after warning

draft_confirm_execute_pattern.description: Two-phase human-in-the-loop write action pattern (Component 25 compatible)
draft_confirm_execute_pattern.phase_1_backend_emits: TOOL_CALL_RESULT with content JSON containing requires_confirmation: true, draft_id, preview_title, preview_detail
draft_confirm_execute_pattern.phase_1_ui: AGUIApprovalGate renders with preview_title and preview_detail; or useAGUIToolCalls for headless
draft_confirm_execute_pattern.phase_2_frontend_sends: approveToolCall(id, toolCall.result) — passes full draft object including draft_id
draft_confirm_execute_pattern.phase_2_backend_receives: POST with tool message; agent calls execute_draft_action(draft_id)
draft_confirm_execute_pattern.phase_2_frontend_state: New TOOL_CALL_RESULT arrives with success: true; status becomes 'complete'

common_mistakes.fix: Declare headers and onError outside the component or use useMemo/useCallback

common_mistakes.symptom: Empty arrays, no-op functions, null state silently
common_mistakes.fix: Ensure the component using hooks is a descendant of AGUIProvider

common_mistakes.symptom: Backend gets {approved: true} without draft_id; no execution
common_mistakes.fix: Call approveToolCall(id, toolCall.result) to forward the draft object
